svg.text: box header 2x32, on the back x 1
Square pad = pad 1: the cathode of a diode or an LED, the plus of an electrolytic, pin 1 of a header.
Grey and unlabelled: the commonest resistor of the card (see the legend) and the 2N7000, flat side as the outline shows. Resistors stand upright on 5.08 mm.
Upright diodes (black, unlabelled): the body stands on the square pad, band down; the bare lead bends over to the round pad.
DIP switches (black pads, named on the silkscreen): a closed switch (ON) is a 1. They work either way round: fit each with ON toward the right edge.
Dashed blue outline: the bus header, soldered on the BACK of the board with its notch toward the top edge (D059). Its 64 pins are soldered on this face.
Drawn from the committed board by sim/assembly.py; the values are the schematic's. Front view, the header along the top edge.
